title: PsychEval: A Multi-Session and Multi-Therapy Benchmark for High-Realism AI Psychological Counselor
reasoning: The paper presents a clinical benchmark for AI psychological counselors. While it evaluates 'Clinical Ethics and Safety' as one of its dimensions (focusing on professional boundaries, crisis markers, and non-maleficence), its primary objective is clinical fidelity and therapeutic realism rather than the evaluation of religion, faith, or general ethical/moral frameworks.
